mechanisms.mechanism: The unstaged and the staged diff are taken with the diff settings of the person's git. An external diff tool (`diff.external`) or a textconv driver then writes the text that is hashed. A tool that prints the same for two states of a file, or nothing at all, hides an edit to a file that was already modified: all four hashes stay the same, and a write by the reviewer goes unnoticed.
mechanisms.trigger: `diff.external` set to a tool that prints nothing, or a textconv driver whose output does not depend on the edited text; then a second edit to a tracked file that is already modified.
mechanisms.why_severity: A definite gap in the one check that tells whether the reviewer wrote to the tree, in a configuration people use. Nothing is lost by it, so it is not P0.

cases: external diff driver: a second unstaged edit
external diff driver: a second staged edit
